display_name: Test: Author notes are not live
description: Test of step 2b: a "_"-prefixed author note never ships to the browser. A unique "SENTINEL-" note sits in every note-capable block a player route can ship (rooms, objects, contents, NPCs, intel facts, feed posts, objectives, tasks, the command board, items held, start items, phone, networks, social/mail, policies, resources), while a room whose id starts with "_" (_annex), a "_" global name and free data (object-valued globals) ship as authored. Nothing to solve.
test_objective: Prove the client payload strips every author note (including the feed intel-fact and GET /objectives routes, which deep_dup a sub-object) while free data and "_" ids ship, through the real player routes
